selected_experts.reason: To confirm the subject matches the 'groom' class label with high confidence, distinguishing from general 'man' or 'businessman'.
To audit the anatomical correctness of the human subject, specifically checking for limb integrity and natural posture despite the partial view.
Floral accessories are common failure points in AI generation; this expert will check if the flower merges correctly with the lapel or floats.
To detect subtle texture anomalies, skin smoothing artifacts, or edge bleeding between the subjects and the brick background.

focus_areas: Anatomical correctness of the face and neck connection
Physical plausibility of the boutonniere attachment to the lapel
Texture consistency of the suit fabric vs. skin
Edge sharpness between subjects and background
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the interaction between the boutonniere and the suit lapel. AI often fails to render the pin mechanism or causes the flower to 'melt' into the fabric. Also, verify that the lighting on the groom's face matches the lighting on the bride to ensure they exist in the same physical space.
